title: SEC0: blob upload response missing accountId (RFC 8620 §6.1)
description: kithd/src/blob.rs blob_upload_handler lines 93-101: the 201 response JSON includes blobId, size, type, sha256 but NOT accountId. RFC 8620 §6.1 requires accountId in the upload response. A strictly-compliant JMAP client that reads accountId from the upload response to validate it matches the requested account will fail. Fix: add "accountId": account_id (or "a-self") to the response JSON object.
